notes.title: Patch 5 - August 20th 2025
notes.content:
[h3]Pause Menu[/h3]
	- [b]Added [View Controls] sub-menu to the in-game pause menu.[/b]
	- [b]Added Player Settings to the in-game pause menu.[/b]

[h3]Practice[/h3]
	- Polished controls info.
	- Added reset puck button.
	- Fixed disabling a player that's holding the puck causing the puck to freeze.

[h3]Settings[/h3]
	- [b]Added descriptions for Icing, Scene, and Fighting settings.[/b]
		
[h3]Tournament Mode[/h3]
	- Fixed CPU vs CPU always counting as a player win.
		
[h3]Menu Polish[/h3]
	- Fixed single-frame camera jerk at the start of the results screen.
	- Minor polish for button prompts and menu windows.
	- Minor polish for title screen.
	- Netplay lobby creation menu can now fit the widest possible lobby name.
	- Added drop shadows to slider values and text prompts.

notes.title: Patch 4 - August 15th 2025
notes.content:
[h3]CPU Players[/h3]
	- [b]Greatly improved and polished offense behaviour.[/b]
	- Fixed CPU players slowing down and jittering slightly before a shot.
	- Fixed CPU players shooting straight forward too often.

[h3]Fighting[/h3]
	- Greatly improved CPU behaviour and difficulty balancing.
	- Fixed softlock caused by players getting stuck on the goal crease after a fight.
	- Fixed rare bug where post-fight faceoff not finishing causes misplaced faceoff in the next match.
		
[h3]Graphics[/h3]
	- [b]Fixed excessive ice-scratches causing black-spots in the ice.[/b]
		
[h3]Pre-Game [/h3]
	- [b]Added setting to disable the pre-game sequence.[/b] (Game Settings -> Scene Settings)
	- Fixed "SKIP" prompt being misaligned for the right side player.
	- Fixed lighting retaining if the player pauses and quits during the sequence.
		
[h3]Menus[/h3]
	- Fixed game settings menu staying on screen if the game is started while it's still on-screen.
